pull_request.title: chore(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group in /apps/cli/devx with 2 updates
pull_request.body:
Bumps the go-minor-patch group in /apps/cli/devx with 2 updates: [github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go](https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go) and [golang.org/x/crypto](https://github.com/golang/crypto). Updates `github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go` from 1.2.0 to 1.2.1
Release notes

Sourced from github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go's releases.

Release v1.2.1

What's Changed

  • fix(oauth): validate resource in well-known protected resource metadata by @​ezynda3 in mark3labs/mcp-go#1053

Full Changelog: https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

Commits
  • 90d247e fix(oauth): validate resource in well-known protected resource metadata (#1053)
  • See full diff in compare view

Updates `golang.org/x/crypto` from 0.57.0 to 0.58.0
Commits
  • 8fdf07b go.mod: update golang.org/x dependencies
  • 2437861 salsa20: fix keystream reuse in LoongArch LSX tail
  • c3db4df acme: prefer test log helpers in test contexts
  • 4e01a84 acme: adds support for profiles draft
  • 8f0f111 ssh: check that no Unicode-aware string function is used
  • b39ff6d ssh: add certificate algorithms for ML-DSA keys
  • 4465db3 ssh: add the ML-DSA public key algorithms
  • 83e695b ssh: implement ETM mode for CBC ciphers
  • 946083a ssh: only drop a trailing carriage return
  • 543dde9 ssh: accept known_hosts entries with a multi-word comment
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
